grammar.matching: primitive integer ray vectors sorted, canonicalize over exact quarter-turns only; no reflection or scaling
reject: Unlisted node signatures including diagonal T and four-way crossings
Door/passage opening not separately adapted to endpoint profile
Any arbitrary scale/reflection or inferred geometry substitution

geometryAuthority: Nominal contact declarations and fitted native geometry only; no pressure/structural strength acceptance

native.coordinateSystem: Blender XY metres, Z height; glTF export X/Y/-Z conversion already applied
native.placement: Translate by originUnits/32 and rotate quarterTurns about Blender Z; never stretch or reflect.

surfaceCoverage.wallEndPorts: Explicit exact ports[] per part; native coplanar triangle validation in validation.json
surfaceCoverage.wallBottom: Actual native bottom equals corePolygonM at .1875m. Floor bevel seam gaps quantified in floor-roof-contact-audit.json; no generic airtight claim.
surfaceCoverage.wallTop: Actual native top equals corePolygonM at3m. Roof contact audit supplied; butt seams and permeability unapproved.

limitations: Only the explicit signature grammar is supported; reject uncovered node/length/profile combinations.
Complete twelve single-floor loops and four mixed fixtures; arbitrary diagonal T/cross/dead-end configurations are not covered.
Gasket/threshold/door behavior remains separately pinned external work.
Mixed-floor bevel paths under walls require new native contact inserts before pressure coverage approval.
No art-derived pressure, mass, strength, flow, inventory, or runtime damage rating.
Working geometry candidate; final art approval remains with owner.
